derivations.claim: Actual shift5 direct flow coefficients are -1/16,-5/48,-5/24,-5/8; last/first magnitude is10.
assumptions: Real arithmetic for the simplified formula

Native BF16 execution retains separate casts and products.

derivations.claim: Local norm ordering and group-energy sorting do not generally order terminal error.
assumptions: Fixed post-Q2 operands for the local identity
Arbitrary downstream linear map in the counterexample
steps: Expand squared norm of sum of removed group contributions, retaining cross terms.
Set L=diag(100,.01), e1=(.01,0), e2=(0,1): local and final norms have opposite order.
derivations.scope: Constructive counterexample; does not assert the actual Wan continuation is L

steps: Combined norm=.1; removing d0 leaves norm=.9.

derivations.claim: H0-H4 equals sum_i(H_i-H_(i+1)) exactly; same for any fixed scalar endpoint score.
assumptions: All relevant state included or matched
H_i uses i dense prefix steps and a fixed UB1 suffix
steps: Define H_i=Psi(S3 o ... o Si(x_i^D)); H4=Psi(x4^D).
Expand adjacent differences; all intermediate endpoints cancel.
Squared endpoint error includes all pairwise inner products of differences.
derivations.scope: Order-dependent finite intervention decomposition, valid for nondifferentiable native maps
derivations.implication: Three intermediate endpoints can diagnose the failure without new training; no Shapley/optimality claim.

derivations.claim: At unchanged UB1 cost, only202.357198ms (3.074081%) added complete-FFN time remains before1.5x is lost.
assumptions: No generalization across hardware or inputs
derivations.scope: Conditional engineering budget, not a timing confidence bound

derivations.claim: Optimal rank-r linear prediction cannot remove residual outside the input feature span.
assumptions: Same centered, square-root-weighted X and E
steps: Decompose E=P_X E+(I-P_X)E into orthogonal components.
Approximate P_X E by its best rank-r SVD.
Minimum risk equals squared orthogonal residual plus singular-value tail.
derivations.scope: Ideal least-squares benchmark; not exact for current ridge/approximate-SVD/BF16 implementation
derivations.implication: Do not recycle small-rank adapters without a distinct feature/state/target mechanism.
